newsitem.title: USA: Foundation Health in talks on combination.
newsitem.headline: Foundation Health in talks on combination.

text.p: Foundation Health Corp said on Monday it has been having talks concerning a combination with another party.
It said the deal being discussed would result in a nominal value to shareholders below Foundation's September 13 closing stock price of $36.13.
If the deal proceeds, it would be on a pooling-of-interests, common-stock basis and is expected to be a merger of equals, it said.

"An important consideration has been and will remain our complete commitment to providing members with quality health care and service at cost-effective prices," said Chief Executive Officer Daniel Crowley.
The company emphasized that there is no assurance that the discussions will lead to a definitive agreement.
Moreover, if an agreement is reached, it will be subject to shareholder approval and other customary conditions, it said.
